I need to preserve a method that detects diagonal pairs of the same color and extends the line along the same vector. For example, I have a pair at (6,2) and (7,1) oriented down-left, and I should extend it up-right to the edge, likely to 9. There's also a demo pair at (16,12) and (17,11) that follows the same down-left orientation, with the extension also going up-right. I can output a confirmation for successful implementation.

p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v==0: continue
            # matching diagonal neighbor down-left; extend same diagonal up-right
            if r+1<h and c-1>=0 and grid[r+1][c-1]==v:
                rr,cc=r-1,c+1
                while rr>=0 and cc<w:
                    out[rr][cc]=v; rr-=1; cc+=1
    return out
''')
